description: Payment evidence. PRICED: $0.002 in USDC on base via x402 -- no account, no API key, no invoice. Call without `payment` to receive the exact payment requirements, then call again with `payment` to be served. On-chain payment evidence for one service: how many payments, how many distinct paying wallets, first and last seen. Read off the chain, not off a claim. Counts are per receiving wallet, so one operator on several hostnames shows the same totals on each.

payment.description: Optional. An x402 X-PAYMENT header value. Omit it to receive the payment requirements for this call; supply it to be served. Price: $0.002

target.description: A domain, URL or indexed service id
